claim_text: 來源機構：韓國教育部；資料標題：디지털 미디어 문해교육, 학교 현장에서 새롭게 만들어 가다；來源刊登日：2026-11-03。內容：韓國教育部新聞稿表示，於 11 月 3 日發布〈學校數位媒體素養教育基本計畫〉。計畫背景寫道，隨社群媒體與 AI 發展，資訊取得與擴散加快、學生參與社會的機會擴大，但網路上的虛假與操縱資訊也大幅增加；計畫並引述 2024 年一項研究，列出青少年自評生成式 AI 使用問題的嚴重程度，以虛假資訊擴散（5 分制 4.18）居首。新聞稿稱，計畫目的在支援學校的數位媒體素養教育，使學生培養批判理解經由媒體取得之資訊、並以媒體審慎溝通的能力。計畫指出，各部會與各市道的數位媒體素養教育範圍與內容不一，並稱隨 AI 與社群媒體發展，需培養超越近用與運用、能批判理解並負責任運用數位媒體的能力。主要推動項目包括：以《數位基礎遠距教育活化基本法》第 10 條所定四項教育要素（近用與運用、理解與批判、社會參與、民主溝通）為中心，訂定涵蓋目標、內容等的教育框架（草案（안），基本計畫註明今後政策推動過程中可能變動），並推動開發與各科課程連結的指引；2027 年起開發分學校層級與年級的教學標準模式及教師研習體系化模式；2027 年起每年新提供約 20 種套裝型教學資料，以課時為單位整合概念說明影片、投影片、學生學習單與形成性評量題目；開發供教師診斷學生程度的評量工具，推動時程（案）為 2027 年開發與試行、2028 年補充與推廣；推動政策研究，以於下次課程修訂時明確納入相關要素（2027 年起）；學生批判性媒體理解能力實態調查予以補充並常態化，時程（案）為 2027 年精修題目與試行、2028 年起正式調查。基本計畫附錄〈框架細部內容〉亦標為草案（안）；草案中「近用與運用」領域的知識・理解列有「對數位裝置、平臺、生成式 AI 等多元媒體環境的理解與安全使用方法」，「理解與批判」領域以「AI 生成資料的可信度與現實扭曲」為因應問題之例，其過程・技能列有「考量 AI 等媒體環境，判斷媒體可信度等並批判閱讀」。說明：基本計畫列 2027 年主要課題所需預算（案）合計 5,092,000 千韓元（〈참고1〉註明含市道對應投資金額），並註明今後政策與事業推動過程中預算可能變動；各課題推動日程亦標為（案）。（AI 輔助整理，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）

original_excerpt: In this work, we analyze publicly available AI usage guidance documents from 35 states in the U.S. and Puerto Rico. … We find that guidance priorities converge on topics anchored in laws such as data privacy and academic integrity, each addressed in 97% of documents. … Across documents, there is a common framing of urgency around AI integration to prepare students for workforce readiness (86%) and promote loosely-defined personalized learning (86%); this urgency framing to use AI is not matched by specific guidance for capacity-building, accountability, and actionability. … Instead, we identify notable similarities and interdependencies between states with shared citations to non-profit organizations like TeachAI (78%) and Code.org (44%), with some states reproducing TeachAI’s model guidance near-verbatim, and peer citations concentrating on a few early states such as Oregon and Washington. … No state includes parents as contributors on these documents, and only five include students.

original_excerpt: Teachers participated in a 2-h training where they learned about research on personalization, explored how to elicit their students’ out-of-school interests, discussed ethical issues of bias, readability, and cultural relevance when personalizing problems, and practiced using ChatGPT to personalize problems. … There were also instances of ChatGPT generating content that teachers felt was inappropriate or biased, showing important instances where teachers may have been engaging in ethical monitoring. … Teacher-in-the-loop personalization may be structurally constrained to particular grain sizes due to time costs, independent of pedagogical preferences of teachers and students, but more research is needed to determine this. … This study was designed to be exploratory, so it did not have a control group that would allow for the comparative analysis of performance outcomes; this is an important direction for future work. … Accordingly, the findings should be interpreted as descriptive and hypothesis-generating within this bounded implementation, rather than as estimates of how frequently these practices occur among teachers or as evidence that the observed patterns will transfer to other grades, curricula, platforms, AI models, or national contexts.

claim_text: 來源機構：Frontiers in Education；資料標題：Chemistry teachers’ research competence following AI-supported professional development: a mixed-methods pre–post study；來源刊登日：2026-11-05。樣本：作者報告研究於 2025–2026 學年在哈薩克南哈薩克地區（South Kazakhstan region）公立中學進行，立意取樣 105 名現任化學教師，年齡 24 至 59 歲。設計：作者稱採以量化為主、內嵌質性成分的混合方法設計；同一組教師於六週專業發展方案前後填答自編問卷（哈薩克語、匿名），作者寫明無比較組或對照組。問卷以五點量尺自陳研究參與、研究能力、對學生社會情緒福祉的監測、對學生學業情緒的覺察與運用 AI 的準備度，另有兩題開放題。方案每週對應一個研究階段，含講解並示範 AI 工具、在自己的化學課堂進行研究、協作反思，表列工具如 ChatGPT、Elicit；作者稱 AI 是支援工具，不取代教師專業判斷，方案另含研究方法訓練與非 AI 數位工具。作者寫明未蒐集學生層級資料，也未以 AI 預測或分類學生情緒狀態。作者所述發現：作者報告基線以研究能力平均分數最低，五個構面彼此正相關；方案後五個構面平均分數皆上升，並稱因屬單組前後測，應解讀為「與參與方案相關的變化，而非方案具因果作用的證據」，也不能特別歸因於 AI。開放題方面，作者報告方案前教師多把 AI 視為備課與搜尋資訊的工具，方案後較常描述 AI 支援研究規劃、資料分析等研究階段；談學生情緒福祉時，強調有系統地監測並納入教學決策的回答多出許多。作者稱其提出的概念模型尚未正式驗證，以 AI 分析學生社會情緒資料屬待檢驗的前瞻應用。限制：作者自述樣本為單一地區 105 名教師；無比較或對照組，不能排除重複測量、成熟、同期專業經驗等替代解釋；資料多為自陳，可能有社會期許等偏誤；只評估短期變化；無法分離 AI 的獨立貢獻。（AI 輔助整理，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）

original_excerpt: Data were collected from 105 chemistry teachers using closed-ended questionnaire scales and two open-ended questions administered before and after a six-week professional development program. … The study was conducted during the 2025–2026 academic year in public secondary schools in the South Kazakhstan region. … As shown in Table 7, mean scores increased across all five constructs following completion of the program. … However, because the study employed a single-group pre-test/post-test design, these improvements should be interpreted as changes associated with program participation rather than as evidence of a causal program effect. … Second, the study employed a single-group pre-test/post-test design without a comparison or control group.

summary_evidence_spans: This study aims to systematically evaluate the usability, acceptability and pedagogical relevance of an AIED-Unplugged learning analytics tool from teachers' perspectives, in order to guide the development of user-centered design strategies and support writing practices in resource-constrained educational settings without deepening digital inequities.
We employed a mixed-methods approach involving nine teachers, who downloaded an AIED-U application and followed a predefined usage scenario according to a think-aloud protocol.

Afterwards, participants filled out the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) and System Usability Scale (SUS) questionnaires, taking part in a moderated semi-structured interview guided by an interview script.

The quantitative findings indicated high levels of acceptance and usability, corroborating the qualitative findings that teachers perceived the solution as useful, easy to integrate and supportive of their practices.
The usability testing of the Escreva Mais was conducted with nine teachers from private and public high schools in Brazil.

original_excerpt: 為培養學生媒體識讀能力，教育部國教署辦理「中小學媒體素養競賽」，鼓勵教師將媒體素養之新興議題融入各學科或各領域，研發創新教材教案。 … 其中，國立新化高中「從粉絲到反思：解析追星文化與意識形態」、國立善化高中「迷因在說話」及國立興大附農「真相築基：我的AI實事求證筆記」等教案，均於教案設計類獲得佳績，展現媒體素養教育融入學生生活經驗的實踐成果。 … 國立善化高中李若薇老師於公民課程規劃6節課，導入《迷因在說話》桌遊，讓學生從遊戲體驗訊息傳遞過程中的資訊落差，學習辨識「事實」與「觀點」，並從生活情境認識青少年常見的數位風險，包括私密影像外流、網路霸凌、人肉搜索、侵犯肖像權與著作權，以及AI生成假影音等問題，培養學生媒體識讀及事實查核能力，強化高風險APP使用安全觀念。 … 課程結合資訊科技與公民領域，透過「破解AI 幻覺」、「根源式AI實作」與「多模態產出與反思」三階段學習活動，引導學生掌握AI時代所需的資訊判讀與查核能力。 … 此外，也開設媒體素養彈性微課程，從學生熟悉的手機APP、網路交友及社群媒體切入，運用「青春網戀模擬器」等互動素材，引導青春期學生認識網路交友可能面臨的陷阱與風險；同時培養學生面對網路謠言、可疑訊息、數位性暴力或AI生成內容時，養成先停下來、查證來源、辨識風險，並尋求可信任協助管道的習慣，提升學生在數位環境中的自我保護能力。 … 為逐步提升學校教師媒體素養知能與融入策略，國教署亦訂定「中小學媒體素養基地學校計畫」， 115學年度補助國立師大附中、國立竹南高中、國立興大附農、國立虎尾高中、國立新化高中、國立善化高中及長榮中學等7校成立基地學校，藉由媒體素養基地學校積極推動，結合AI新興科技發展趨勢，協助教師研發媒體素養相關教材教案。
